description: Defines the NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid class and its nested Observer interface, which handle thread-safe notifications of network changes on Android via JNI, including connection type, cost, bandwidth, and network connectivity events.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid
classes.description: Handles thread-safe notifications of network changes on Android, interfacing with Java via JNI, and managing observers for connection type, cost, bandwidth, and network events.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that observe network change events such as connection type, cost, bandwidth, and default network activity.

methods.name: NotifyConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update connection type and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyConnectionCostChanged
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update connection cost and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyMaxBandwidthChanged
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update max bandwidth and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkConnect
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate a network connection event.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate a network is about to disconnect.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkDisconnect
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate a network disconnection.

methods.name: NotifyPurgeActiveNetworkList
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to update active network list.

methods.name: NotifyOfDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Called from Java JNI thread to indicate default network is active.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for network change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from network change notifications.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserverRemoved
methods.description: Notifies delegate that a default network active observer was removed.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserverAdded
methods.description: Notifies delegate that a default network active observer was added.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Returns the current network connection cost.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves current max bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the connection type for a given network handle.

methods.name: GetCurrentDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Returns the current default network handle.

methods.name: GetCurrentlyConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Fills a list with currently connected networks.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Checks if the default network is active.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns the current connection subtype; main thread only.

methods.name: RegisterNetworkCallbackFailed
methods.description: Indicates if network callback registration failed.
